title: Samsung 16" Galaxy Book6 Laptop (Core Ultra 5 325, 16GB, 512GB)

comparisons.notes: Samsung's buy page for NP760VJG-KA1US: 16-inch non-touch, Core Ultra 5 325, 16GB, 512GB, Gray. Same hardware as Woot's NP760VJG-KA2US; only the channel suffix differs. No out-of-stock flag shown.
NP760VJG-KA1US: 16-inch 1920x1200, Core Ultra 5 325, 16GB LPDDR5X, 512GB SSD, Gray, Windows 11 Home. Page says Limited Quantity Available.

writeup: Samsung's 16-inch Galaxy Book6 (NP760VJG) pairs an Intel Core Ultra 5 325 with 16GB of LPDDR5X memory, a 512GB SSD and a 1920x1200 display running Windows 11 Home. Woot has it new for $699.99, while Samsung's own store charges $1,349.99 and Connection lists it at $1,477.02, so you save about $650. Woot showed only 1 left, limit 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN B0GND82D5T matches Samsung Galaxy Book6 16-inch NP760VJG-KA2US per verified exact-match check; Woot's computers listing for the same ASIN says New.
